closure_reason: P1 NATIVE was the first fixed path and failed the absolute detailed real-tick integrity gate on all three required symbols despite the HTML 100 percent label. The matrix terminated before candidate paths or economic comparison.
authoritative_findings: The frozen forward source does implement the native hold vector 8/12/4/8/6/16 and supports a minimal three-profile direct intervention without changing signals, stops, risk or ARC semantics.
The first dedicated P1 NATIVE run exited normally and logged the exact NATIVE vector.
Its detailed agent log reported every-tick generation substitution for both absent and discarded real ticks on US100, US30 and US500.
The predeclared integrity gate therefore failed before SHORT_25, LONG_25 or any authoritative economic metric was opened.
not_established: whether SHORT_25 improves or harms paired stressed R
whether LONG_25 improves or harms paired stressed R
whether either profile changes portfolio net, drawdown, efficiency, stop rate, occupied hours or durable births acceptably
whether the current NATIVE schedule is economically optimal

decision_translation.preserve: Keep the frozen NATIVE production hold vector by default because no valid challenger was measured, not because Unit 060 proved it optimal.

decision_translation.additional_observation_needed: A valid direct hold-curve answer would require newly available, independently pinned complete real-tick coverage for every required symbol and a fresh declaration. This observation gap does not authorize an automatic environment repair or rerun.
